name: claude-getting-started
description: Starter slash commands and a local code-review plugin for Claude Code.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Local, semantic PR reviews powered by the IntelliJ IDE Index MCP server plus the JetBrains command-line code inspector. Catches cross-file impact bugs via project-wide semantic queries, with breadth coverage from JetBrains' built-in inspection set, without cloud indexing.
